scope: Nine exact table CDK uses; source decisions and bounded current probe observations; no coordinator or private API stability claim.

reviews.reviewer: Codex source and bounded producer review
reviews.decision: CdkNoDataRow remains the public CDK parent used by the owned legacy directive. The current no-data probe reran the original and both archived peer subjects with six rejecting controls, limited to its actual constructor and renderer-protocol scope. The prior review's description of underscore-prefixed fields as nondeprecated does not establish stable public APIs; their existing use is subject to the separate named no-data exception. No complete Angular node, current 21.x artifact, packed or floor qualification follows.

prior_complete_case.decision: CdkNoDataRow is the genuine public parent used by the legacy directive provider, inheritance and borrower construction. Exact SRI/sha256 rehashed complete original16/current CDK archives supply actual namespace exports, not a copied parent or private-token compatibility shim. Both minimum public declarations expose nondeprecated templateRef, _contentClassNames, _cellClassNames and _cellSelector; the whole owned class and helper strictly compile against both complete peer namespaces with skipLibCheck:false using borrowed TS6.0.3, without qualifying compiler floors. Complete owned constructors execute with actual public Core/parent values and native Chromium DOM: required manual template identity, genuine parent/owned prototypes and unchanged peer default settings are observed. Whole untouched original/current table renderer methods are replayed through explicit embedded-view/outlet/change-detector protocols. Seven cases preserve every DOM class/attribute and empty/data/empty transition from immutable Original16. Pre-repair source, missing selector guard and wrong root class fail on each current floor. The repair sets fresh empty cell classes and a no-match cell selector through stable declared public fields; this avoids both added CDK classes and the empty class attribute created by classList.add with zero arguments. Constructors, providers, rendered component templates, 409 stylesheets, other library behavior and consumer source remain unchanged. Actual full CdkTable/owned directive node/factory/AOT/packed application and canonical runtime/compiler/RxJS/browser floors remain final Actions/audit obligations. This closes only this finite public parent/configuration boundary, not the entire table or G11.

prior_complete_case.decision: This finite public import belongs to the column/cell constructor or private interop bridge. Complete SRI/sha256 rehashed original/current CDK packages supply genuine public namespace values; complete original/owned modules execute in Chromium with actual public Core decorators, public CDK parent constructors and the complete borrower helper. Two full current peer declaration namespaces strictly compile the complete cell and class-helper modules with skipLibCheck:false and verify every imported public declaration plus public name/cssClassFriendlyName/sticky/table members as nondeprecated and not docs-private. Borrowed TS6 does not qualify compiler floors. All 288 original/main/21.x final class comparisons agree: owned and mixed-CDK header/data/footer/native/flex cells, sanitized and renamed names, and raw CDK columns. Six true native mutations reject missing weak ownership, absent mixed bridge and absent owned cell handling. The new helper uses a weak ownership set and public cssClassFriendlyName; it never reads/mutates current private class arrays or calls private name/class hooks. Constructor arguments, current public parent/owned prototypes and supplied table identity are retained. Existing public selectors/providers and product CSS/SCSS/HTML are unchanged; Cyph has no private-hook or column subclass uses. The private bridge matches public CDK cell selectors only to preserve historical mixed-cell behavior and exports no modern API mirror. Actual Angular node/module/factory/AOT/packed integration and supported runtime/compiler/RxJS/browser floors remain deferred; only this finite source/public-construction/class-output boundary is admitted, not the whole table or G11.

prior_complete_case.decision: The named @angular/cdk/table HeaderRowOutlet identifier is absent from the current owned table-module source; that file still imports the public CdkTableModule. Material 16 legacy table-module likewise imported CdkTableModule, while the installed 22.1.7 outlet class is marked docs-private. Current owned table template uses a local outlet bridge whose explicitly excepted CdkTable underscore hooks remain real peer implementation dependencies. This removed direct source use grants no table rendering, provider, native, packed or runtime equivalence.

The frozen HeaderRowOutlet occurrence at legacy-table/table-module.ts is removed from the maintained source. The only executable reference was a redundant NgModule imports entry; the existing public CdkTableModule import already exports the identical outlet class binding, with complete exact minimum declaration/runtime export metadata independently inspected. No selector, template, provider, table parent, row/outlet implementation or style behavior changes. The public module retains the outlet directive scope on both actual minimum versions. Close this obsolete direct private binding only; runtime/template/AOT/packed and all other table/DI/manual-constructor obligations remain separate. Subsequent table outlet ownership repair changes only inert outlet bindings and their internal protocol; the historical unchanged-emit statement above belongs to its original captured subject. The unused direct outlet imports remain absent on this source. Fresh tagged outlet/section/ownership execution, both minimum declaration proofs and genuine public-parent diagnostics support the current binding; native/packed and original table manual construction remain unqualified. Fresh complete AST inspection renews the module source cap after the definition-owner wiring repair: all four direct retired outlet bindings remain absent, and the root public CdkTableModule binding remains in NgModule imports. Reintroducing each retired class into either module or table source rejects (eight controls). The earlier original-removal emit identity remains scoped to its recorded subject; current template/table behavior stays a separate audit obligation. Scoped current-source requalification: the column/cell repair keeps all prior class/parameter decorators and constructor arguments. Sticky code is unchanged; the module adds only one private bridge declaration/export/import. Former private CDK class-array/name hooks are removed. Public name/cssClassFriendlyName and complete actual owned/current parent construction preserve authentic16 final classes in 288 native comparison cases. The bridge is manually constructed; actual node/module/packed integration is deferred. No full node/factory/packed/floor scope is added.
